title: Peckern
safeHtml:
Peckern is one of the main areas of Los Sengas, and it is located to the west of the West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA). The representative color of Peckern in Los Sengas is Green, and the District Number is 7. This district is located within the Peckern Continent, and is currently managed by DaOrangeStoneOre.

On January 15 2017, this district had a brief merger with Peckern North, and the area was shrunk to the east of Peckern Forest. However, as of right now, Peckern North and Peckern are two separate districts, with the west boundary of this district extending to Intus Occident once again. With this in mind, these two districts are now separate by Yan Shing Road. After January 2020, the Peckern Government has drawn the area of Treeless Hill and Milead Pond as the South Peckern Sub-District to give a clearer boundary of development.

On January 8 2021, the boundary of Peckern and Peckern North has been redrawn, with Peckern District extending to the south of Route 12 and the entire Heart Peninsula, meaning that the Peckern Government now manages all past development areas in Peckern Continent.

On May 4 2022, the northwestern part of Airship Island became a part of this district, and the entire Airship Island became a part of this district on May 6 2023.

Peckern City Circular is one of the lines in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme which began construction in Period 2. Currently, this line has 14 stations and totals 23km in length (Excluding the 5-km Section of Phase 3 which has yet to be approved).

History[]

  • August 1 2017: Phase I Route (Between Arcgo West Rocks and Silver Plateau) construction approved.
  • August 25 2018: Phase I Route (Between Arcgo West Rocks and Silver Plateau) began services.
  • September 6 2018: Phase II Route (Between Silver Plateau and Landing Pole) construction approved.
  • December 27 2020: Section 1 of Phase II (Between Silver Plateau and Dufol) began services.
  • April 4 2021: Section 2 of Phase II (Between Dufol and Treeless Hill) began services.
  • September 25 2021: Section 3 of Phase II (Between Treeless Hill and Peckern Park) began services.
  • October 16 2021: Section 4 of Phase II (Between Peckern Park and Purple Gate) began services.
  • June 5 2022: Section 5 of Phase II (Between Purple Gate and Senriyama) temporarily began services.
  • June 26 2022: Senriyama station structure complete. Section 5 officially began services.
  • October 2 2022: Section 6 of Phase II (Between Senriyama and Landing Pole) began services.

title: Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport
safeHtml:
Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport, formally named Los Sengas Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport and commonly abbreviated as Peckern North Eternal Airport[1], is a proposed airport in Peckern North.

Description[]

  • Area: Approximately 6.677 km2
  • Passenger Termini: 1, with two wings
  • Runways: 2, One 4200m long and one 3500m long
  • Helipads: N/A
  • Boarding Gates: Approximately 40

This airport formerly crosses three different districts, namely the north of Festival, the west of Peckern North and the southeast of Goldpoint. The relocated airport is planned to be located to the north of Northern Dansein New Town, which would become the auxiliary town of this airport. Plans of this airport also included the Route 12A extension and appurtenant works near Fall Point Gateway.

History[]

This airport was originally named Alice Margatroid Airport after the Touhou Project character of the Same Name. At the time, this airport had a passenger terminal, 51 boarding gates, and a runway that has yet to be marked. However, due to historical reasons, the Original builder of the airport left Project Nazca, and while the player who took over airport development also refurbished parts of the passenger terminal, the involvement of another Peckern North developer had meant that the airport would be relocated. As a result, the Old Airport Structure is completely demolished and now forms part of the Northwest Stadiums Area.

After relocation, several suggestions have been given regarding the new name of the airport, such as:

  • Great Grundorf Airport, and
  • Peckern Continent Eternal Soaring International Airport[2]

To compliment airport relocation, Temporary Traffic Regulations have been put in place. Firstly, Route 12 have undergone reconstruction to compliment Northwest Stadiums Area development, and the carriageway have also widened to compliment Route 412 construction. In terms of Railways, a Station of the same name as the airport is demolished as it shared structures with the original Airport Passenger Terminal. Currently, Tokaido Line services currently only ran between Senriyama Station and Water Beach Station, with stations to the west of Water Beach suspending services until further notice.

The location of the airport completed reclamation works on January 8 2024 and began construction on the same day.

Citations and References[]

  1. ↑ The abbreviation is taken from its location Peckern North and took the shorter word "Eternal" instead of "Eternity"
  2. ↑ The English Name of this variant was deviated from the Chinese Name.

Description []

Peckern Line is an east-west oriented line of Peckern Transit in Los Sengas, and runs between Peckern and Festival.

This line is represented by dark green on the Route Map, and is Line Number 1.

History[]

  • May 1 2017: Kasukano Train Railway shuts down, and this line is taken over by Los Sengas Government.
  • May 6 2017: Peckern Transit (Named Peckern Metro at the time) is established and takes over this line.
  • June 4 2018: This line became a part of the Co-Op Railway.
  • August 2020: New Phantasm Station and Kinpriate Place Station have been renamed Cylupus Valley and Kanjono de Maho respectively.
  • September 21 2023: Peckern Metro is renamed Peckern Transit.

Districts Served[]

  • Festival
  • Peckern

Line Charcteristics[]

  • All stations use new signs.
  • All stations have announcements.
  • All stations have a departure routine.

title: Peckern North
safeHtml:
Peckern North is one of the Districts of Los Sengas. It is located to the west of the West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA) and to the north of Peckern. The representative color of Peckern in Los Sengas is Dark Green, and the District Number is 8. Similar to Peckern, this district is also located within the Peckern Continent, and is also currently managed by DaOrangeStoneOre.

This district had briefly merged with Peckern from January 15 2017. However, on March 4 2018, this district once again became a district on its own and became District Number 8 due to rapid development from Senriyama (Now a part of Peckern District). On January 8 2021, after redrawing its border with Peckern, it now became a separate District to manage newest development in North Peckern Continent. Currently, this District is home to Dansein and the Tin Shek Development areas, and houses a population of 400 thousand, while projecting 600 thousand in a short term.

Peckern Pond Station is a station on West Ring Line and Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Peckern. Passengers may also use this station to change to Peckern Transit Peckern Line (Peckern Park Station), Cities Transit Peckern City Circular (Peckern Park Station) and SLT Line 813 Peckern Pond Stop[2].

title: Peckern Transit
safeHtml:
Peckern Transit (PT), formally named Peckern Transit by NR and formerly named Peckern Metro (PM), is the successor of Kasukano Train Railway (Los Sengas) (KTR). It was established on May 6 2017 to take over lines that are formerly ran by KTR. On June 4 2018 all the lines under this operator became a part of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. On August 1 2023, all Peckern Metro Stations temporarily fell under Nazca Railway jurisdiction in order to fully fit the Peckern Metro Stations with the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme, and on September 21 2023, Peckern Metro is officially renamed Peckern Transit.

Pegasus Line is Line Number 27 of NR Los Sengas Division. This line has 39 stations, and was established on February 14 2022. It runs between Keene Hamlet and Black Tea Lake.

Description[]

Pegasus Line is one of the two lines involved in the "Strategic Line Project" of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, with the other line being Phoenix Line.

The line starts from Intus Aquilo, and traverses south to the east of the Upper Rover area within Rover Peninsula, before reaching Peacean Island and passing through Youngsters, Katadelphia, Downtown, Numpool Island of West Metropolis Archipelago, TriPaw, Oasis Bay and Jupiter, before arriving at Black Tea Lake Station, which does not have a district yet. However, even before this line was established, it is already known that this line would pass through Metropolis, Wilde Street, Central Numpool and Snipe Valley.

This route is represented by Azure on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 27.

Currently, this route is 68.015 km long, with a total of 39 stations.

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the two Strategic Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • After this line's extension to Densewood, this line became the first line with the most station types with the line has all station types.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • The Shuttle: Metropolis to Central Numpool, Old Brightland
    • Lima Line (East): Metropolis to Old Brightland

Fun Facts[]

  • This line passes through the most Standard Railway Stations that shares structure with The Shuttle, at three stations, including Metropolis, Central Numpool and Old Brightland.[1]
  • The Development of Season 3 Interlude 6 not only ensures that this line will have the same number of stations as Phoenix Line by the end of Season 3, but also rectifies the Upbound Direction of Travel from Southeast to Southwest.[2]
  • Most Stations along the line are indicated by leaves behind iron bars or glass panels at the Platform Level.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is one of the three stations built to commemorate PeriodSquirrel, a former administrator of Project Nazca who left Project Nazca due to historical reasons, with the other two stations being Comrel Island Station and Squirrel Tail Station. The color scheme of this station was proposed by PeriodSquirrel.
  • This station is the fourth station to be named after a Punctuation Mark, with the first three being Brackox Station, Backcomma Beach Station and Comrel Island Station.
  • A circular staircase is built at this station to connect across the floors of this station and alludes to the Punctuation Mark of Full Stop.
  • An Abbreviation of PeriodSquirrel (PS) is written in different building materials at each level of this station as follows:
    • Concourse: Glowstone
    • Platform 1 Lobby: Purpur Block
    • Platform 2 Lobby: Stone Brick
  • While the Platform Screen Doors of this station were originally built with Purple and White Stained Glass[2], they have since been replaced by ordinary glass panes in order to make Stained Glass Platform Screen Doors a characteristic of Group 1 Gateways.

History[]

  • May 17 2017: This station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • While the Lima Line platforms of this Station are not yet built, reserved structures for Lima Line are seen at the Concourse of this Station in a fashion similar to Spinstone Plane Station prior to its Kilo Line expansion. However, unlike in the case for that station, in which the line for the reserved struture is not known until the line is established, it is already made clear that the reserved structures in this station are for Lima Line.

History[]

  • February 26 2026: This Station began construction.
  • February 28 2026: This Station completed construction.

title: Phantasia Metro
safeHtml:
Phantasia Metro, abbreviated as PHM, is one of the operators involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It was established with the purpose of taking over Bonyal to Cyan Loop Line, which was operated by Great City Railway.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Operations
    • 2.1 Railways
  • 3 Citations and References

History[]

  • May 2021: Established.
  • May-June 2021: Took over Bonyal to Cyan Loop Line of Great City Railway.
  • April 2022: Took over OasisPaw Line of Traveler City Transit Railway.
  • July 2023: The development of Neko Line was approved.
  • July 11 2025: The development of Fuurin Line was approved.

Operations[]

Railways[]

  • Bonyal to Cyan Loop Line: A line handed over to Phantasia Metro that was built in Period 1 of the Co-Op Railway.
  • OasisPaw Line: A line handed over to Phantasia Metro that was built in Period 3 of the Co-Op Railway.
  • Neko Line: A line built in the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between Twin Cliffs and Abunest.
  • Fuurin Line: A line built in the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between Lens and Barren Valley.

Phoenix Line is Line Number 28 of NR Los Sengas Division. This line has 42 stations, and was established on July 24 2022. It runs between Fall Point and Cyban.

Description[]

Phoenix Line is one of the two lines involved in the "Strategic Line Project" of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, with the other line being Pegasus Line.

The line starts from Peckern North and runs eastwards, reaching the south coast of Odyssey, before passing through through Sava, Downtown, Katadelphia, Flask, Punctual and Cometsilk, finally arriving at Prymea and Borealis. However, even before this line was established, it is already known that this line would pass through Vayler North, Sincerity Cove, Metropolis and Candor Plains.

This route is represented by Dim Yellow on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 28.

Currently, this route is km long, with a total of 42 stations.

History[]

  • S3E18: Metropolis - Arrowhead
  • S3E19: Helios - Arrowhead

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Northeast from the Zero Station of Metropolis Terminal within Downtown, before turning southeast and extending to Katadelphia North, Flask, Punctual and Cometsilk. Completed
(Chapter: S3E18)
Down Extend Southwest from the Zero Station of Metropolis Terminal, before turning northwest and extending to Threeler and Sava. Completed
(Chapter: S3E19)

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend southeast and interchange with Oasis Bay Line at the border of Borealis continent. Under Construction
(Chapter: S4E11)
Down Extend west and run parallel with Golf Line, interchanging once more with Odyssey Circular and then Stadow Line in the process. Completed
(Chapter: S4E2)

Districts Served[]

  • Peckern North
  • Odyssey
  • Sava
  • Downtown
  • Katadelphia
  • Flask
  • Punctual
  • Cometsilk
  • Prymea
  • Borealis

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the two Strategic Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Bravo Line (East): Metropolis to Flask East
    • Delta Line (East): Metropolis to Arrowhead
    • Fox Line (West): Metropolis to Flask North
    • Golf Line: Helios to Fall Point
    • Lima Line (West): Metropolis to Mayler Airport (Through Maysang West Station and Skyward Line)

Fun Facts[]

  • This line passes through four different Checkpoints, and caused two existing Area Stations (Flask East, West Shoal) to become checkpoints.
  • Most Stations along the line are indicated by stained glass behind the tracks at the Platform Level.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Endless Decimal Dance.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Endless Decimal Dance 02:52
The Circle's Infinity 02:45

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after the fact that two lakes exist beneath a small river at the vicinity of this station at the time of this station's construction, which resemble the greek letter Pi (π), and in turn alludes to the Mathematical constant of Pi, hence the Chinese Name of this station.[2] However, the river and the two lakes have since disappeared due to development in the surrounding area.
  • A section of eight tracks running in parallel exists to the east of this station.
  • The Kilo Line switch locations is slightly behind compared to the boarding position at the center of the platform. This arrangement is similar to that of the Phoenix Line Platforms at Fosina Station.

History[]

  • November 3 2017: This station began services alongside Stadium Line and Bravo Line, but Kilo Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • February 20 2018: Kilo Line extends from Spinstone Plane Station to this Station.
  • March 14 2020: This Station begin adoptings signs featuring the Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System.[3]
  • December 31 2022: Exit C is added to this Station.[4]
  • June 20 2023: The Station Characteristic Banner of this station is added.
  • March 21 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]
  • May 1 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0.5
  • Scale down the cliff at the north end of the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals Pier Cliff Terminal.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a stick.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Coop
    • Buttons
    • Roles

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2.5-3
  • Two Players are needed to obtain the Station Gauntlet in this station.
  • It is highly recommeded that the Station Gauntlet be attempted when the number of online players is lower to increase the chances of success.
  • It is impossible to press all the buttons within seventy seconds, or is it possible that some do not have to be pressed?
  • Make sure that your internal timer is in sync with your partner's.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a piece of paper.

Fun Facts[]

  • The design of this station pays tribute to 3Pier Station in Terracept Division.

History[]

  • June 6 2015: This station began services.
  • May 12 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • December 6 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[7]
  • September 24 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • March 5 2023：The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • September 27 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[9]
  • November 15 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[10]

Pin Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is a subsidiary isle of Ponrest Island.

Location[]

Pin Isle is located to the east of Frigate Group and the southwest of Ponrest Island.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is entirely located within the "Pinestand Stadium" beneath the ground level of the north Lower Audience Stand. A similar arrangement of station location is seen at The Colonnade Station.
  • The distance between this staiton and Europa Checkpoint is three times that with Grandview Bay Station at 1890m and 640m respectively.
  • Exit A of this station features the first ever large-scaled Exit Banner in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This design alludes to the entrance of Kowloon Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[2]
  • While the setting up of this staiton is inspired by Red Stadium Station with regards that it is built near a stadium with a skylight available to view the sky, the design of this station uses properties from Oasis Bay Line Stations. However, unlike Red Stadium Station, this station is built inside the stadium itself.
  • The orange color is used in this station to allude to the color scheme of Pinestand Stadium.[3]
  • Due to insufficient space, the toilets and station control room of this station is built within the stadium structure instead of at the station structure.

History[]

  • October 6 2020: This station completed construction. At the same day, this station began services.

Pinewatch Station is a station on Oasis Bay Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Prymea.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station pays tribute to Pinestand Station with regards that both stations are named after Pine Trees. Noticeably, the name of this station gives the meaning of "Viewiing the Racecourse from a high ground".
  • This Station is located directly beneath Route 15, and is the first instance of Nazca Railway building a new station directly beneath a highway bridge since Pingsing Station. Other similar instances include San Annis, Coast Edge and Thick River.
  • This Station, alongside Robertson Station and Element Hub Transit Basin Versant Station, are all located within the Prymea Racetrack. This Station also features Crowd Control measures in a fashion similar to Eclipse Fields Station.[2]
  • Oasis Bay Line features a section that enables passenger to travel directly to Commons Creek. This makes Mount Qin West and Spring Point the third and fourth respective stations that passengers can skip through while riding on the same line, with the first two being Metro Stone of the West Ring Line and Harvest River of the Cometsilk Line. This also marks the first instance where a Through Service is applied within the same line.[3]

  • July 24 2026: This Station began construction.
  • July 28 2026: This Station completed construction.

title: Pingsing Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Pingsing Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Arcgo Line. It is located to the west of Landing Pole Station and to the east of Pingsing Station. It has a designed Capacity of up to 12 nine-carriage trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
  • 2 Gallery
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

  • Three tracks in total
  • Each track has a capacity of four 9-carraige trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

Both ends of the Stabling Sidings connect to Arcgo Line tracks. The west end leads to Pingsing Station, and the east end leads to Landing Pole Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Color Scheme of this station alludes to theme of the Season 2 Spin-off, which is named "The Curse", and red, when combined with purple, is usually associated to magic.[2]
  • Despite being an elevated station, this station is completely enclosed on all sides at the platforms and appear as though it is underground. Not only is this station located completely beneath the Peckern Viaduct, the station, as well as the connecting tracks at both sides of this station, are completely covered by sound barriers. This arrangement alludes to San Annis Station, which is also an elevated station on Arcgo Line. However, unlike San Annis Station, where the concourse is enclosed as well, it is possible to view the sea outside from both ends of the concourse of this station.
  • The Pingsing Stabling Sidings is located to the east of this station.
  • While this station is not a Season 3 Station, it has laid the foundation of Season 3 Stations with the regard that Station Facilities use more varying textures.[3][4]

History[]

  • August 19 2018: This Station began services.

title: Pisces Pond
safeHtml:
Pisces Pond was a lake in Los Sengas. Its vicinity has defined the Pisces Pond Sub-District.

Contents

  • 1 Geography
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
  • 3 Citations and References

Geography[]

Pisces Pond consisted of two lakes, and has also formed its namesake. However, one of the lakes was covered by roads due to subsequent development, and only one of them is left.

The natural terrain of this area is unidentifiable. What is known was that there used to be two lakes. Another lake that received similar treatment is Origin Pond.

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • West Ring Line Pisces Pond Station

What is known was that there used to be two lakes. Another lake that received similar treatment is Origin Pond . Pisces Pond Station is a station on West Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Great City Railway Lakebound Line (Restin East Station) and SLT Line 211 (Pisces Pond NR Station Stop).

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Coloured Wool is scattered all across the station. Find the colors and solve the problem.
  • The glowstones guide the direction of the coloured wool.

The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a cooked salmon.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the third Area Station to be built in Los Sengas Division.
  • This station is the first station in Los Sengas to be named after the Astrological Signs of the Zodiac.

History[]

  • March 19 2015: This station began services.
  • January 31 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • December 16 2016: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[5]
  • March 31 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • February 17 2022: The Station Banners and the "Station Gauntlet" of this station are set up.[7]

Plantcell Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is a subsidiary isle of Rollhill Island.

Location[]

Plantcell Isle is located to the northwest of Rollhill Island and the south of Ponrest Island. Stadow Line passes under this isle.

Radiant Lunar 01:13

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station in Nazca Railway to be set up on an isle-class island. While railways were originally forbidden on isle-class islands, that rule was for Island Owners only, and at the time of the setting up of this rule, islands to the north of Northtip Island have not been found yet.[3]
  • This Station adopts the Station Design and color schemes from Grensis Island Station and Finnick Station at the same time. While the Southern Part of this station (The Side closer to Grensis Island) uses Green and building materials from Grensis Island Station, the Northern Part of this station (The Side closer to The Finnick Island) uses Red and Black with building materials from Finnick Station. In other words, this station does not have its own color. This design is due to the fact that the owner of Platform Isle at the time was indecisive regarding the style of this station.[4]
  • Despite being built and having completed construction at the same time as Finnick Station, as this station was connected by tracks earlier than Finnick Station, the station number of this station is smaller than that of Finnick Station.
  • This Station does NOT feature platform passageways.
  • The Stairs of this station resemble shapes of spaghetti due to lack of underground space and the irregularity of the island shape.[5]
  • One of the walls of the Station Control Room at the South Concourses uses characteristics from the North Concourse.

History[]

  • May 27 2018: This Station completed construction alongside Finnick Station.[6]
  • May 28 2018: This Station began services alongside Finnick Station.
  • March 28 2024: The Station Title Banner and Station Icons of this station are added.
